meta.title: Amirreza Jolani — Sunset Island
meta.description: Drive around a pixel-art island to explore the work of Amirreza Jolani Mameghani, Fullstack Engineer in Milan who helped scale Pillar from 1M€ to 4M€ ARR.

profile.title: Fullstack Engineer
profile.bio: Fullstack Engineer with 6+ years of experience building production web apps in TypeScript. At Pillar, a fast-growing construction-software startup in Milan, I helped scale the product from 1M€ to around 4M€ ARR, shipping features end to end from data model to interface. Expert in React and Next.js, with a backend-leaning bent on Node.js and Deno: Zod validation at API boundaries, consistent error handling, third-party integrations and root-cause analysis of real production failures.
profile.funFact: I speak Persian, English, some Italian and some German. My MSc research at Padua was on AI-driven personalisation and adaptive UX.

product.title: Product
product.text: Features from analysis to delivery: compliance docs, Stripe upsell checkout, i18n across 4 markets

fullstack.title: Full-Stack
fullstack.text: React, Next.js, Node.js, Deno, tRPC and Zod on PostgreSQL, Supabase and Redis

ai.title: AI-Native
ai.text: Claude Code, agent skills, MCP and LangGraph.js to ship faster

pillar.text: Helped scale Pillar's construction-software startup from 1M€ to 4M€ ARR. Shipped a compliance-document module, a site-contact module and a seat-based Stripe upsell checkout, instrumented PostHog, and closed i18n gaps for Spain, Colombia, Mexico and Brazil. Cut monorepo lint passes from ~71s to ~9s and Vercel builds by ~45%.

ofoundation.text: Led the design and architecture of a TypeScript e-commerce platform from Figma to production. Cut production incidents 40% with Sentry, deploy time 25% with Docker CI/CD, and raised accessibility from WCAG A to AA with Lighthouse scores of 90–100.

karhuno.text: Built and owned the core platform of an early-stage B2B sales-signal startup. Standardised Zod validation across API boundaries and added Playwright e2e tests with visual regression and API mocking.

padua.text: Moved from Iran to Italy for a master's on the Cybersystems track. My thesis research covered AI-driven personalisation and adaptive, inclusive UX.

pap.text: Built Django REST services for travel-agency sites, cutting backend bugs 25%. Led a Vue.js + Tailwind + Pinia component library that cut repeated work 35%, and sped up LCP/INP by ~2s.

zharfa.text: Built a full-stack MVP with Vue.js and Python/Django in weeks, including token auth and role-based access control.

almas.text: Built the dashboard for Nikan Hospital's patient platform, used daily by medical staff, with Chart.js reports for patient records.

appversion.text: Node.js agent skill that applies SemVer bumps, updates the changelog and cuts tagged GitHub Releases from commit history. Runs in Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

nodebase.text: React SPA with a visual node-based editor (React Flow), real-time data flows and background jobs. Type-safe APIs via tRPC + Prisma/PostgreSQL, auth via Better Auth.

prompter.text: Full-stack platform with Python, Django and PostgreSQL behind a TypeScript client (shadcn/ui + Tailwind, Zod), Dockerised for local/production parity.

marketplace.text: Modular platform with a CMS-style architecture and a Python/Django REST API layer, with end-to-end type safety.

elevenlabs.text: Uses the ElevenLabs API for AI text-to-speech. A LangChain + RAG extension for document-grounded voice answers is in progress.

clara.quote: A true team player — always ready to help, collaborate, and lift the whole group forward. Amirreza brings both technical depth and a great attitude to every sprint.

massy.quote: Works with empathy and professionalism. Makes teamwork smoother and every project more enjoyable. One of the best engineers I’ve had the pleasure to work with.

mohammad.quote: Supportive, reliable, and solution-oriented. He strengthens any team he’s part of. His ability to translate complex requirements into clean UI is exceptional.
